sentences.pinyin: Bùshǒu shì “mù” de zì hěn duō.
sentences.usage: Explaining the commonality of the radical 木 in Chinese characters.

sentences.pinyin: “Huǒ” zuòwéi piānpáng biǎoshì yǔ huǒ yǒuguān.
sentences.translation: The affix “火” indicates relation to fire.
sentences.usage: Describing the meaning of the affix 火 in character components.

sentences.chinese: 汉字的结构分为左右、上下等。
sentences.pinyin: Hànzì de jiéjiù fēnwéi zuǒyòu, shàngxià děng.
sentences.translation: Chinese characters are structured into left-right, top-bottom, etc.

sentences.chinese: 形声字由形旁和声旁组成。
sentences.pinyin: Xíngshēngzì yóu xíngpáng hé shēngpáng zǔchéng.
sentences.translation: Phono-semantic compounds consist of shape and sound components.
sentences.usage: Explaining the composition of 形声字 (phono-semantic characters).

sentences.chinese: “日”在字中常表示时间或光明。
sentences.pinyin: “Rì” zài zì zhōng cháng biǎoshì shíjiān huò guāngmíng.
sentences.translation: “日” often denotes time or light in characters.
sentences.usage: Describing the semantic role of 日 in character components.

sentences.chinese: 月字旁的字多与身体或时间有关。
sentences.pinyin: Yuèzì páng de zì duō yǔ shēntǐ huò shíjiān yǒuguān.
sentences.translation: Characters with the moon radical often relate to the body or time.
sentences.usage: Linking the 月 radical to semantic themes.
